title: Baby in Jumper Chair in Sunny Garden, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black-and-white outdoor snapshot capturing a sweet infant standing upright in a metal-framed baby jumper or walker chair on a grassy lawn. The child wears a dark smocked dress adorned with a wide white scalloped lace collar, paired with little socks and classic white lace-up infant shoes. In the background, lush garden greenery climbing a trellis and the sunlit roofline of a house evoke the cozy atmosphere of mid-century suburban family life.
